data.narrative:
Dusty Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Tessa Lau and Philipp Herget that has raised $70M+. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 9 private robotics companies and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ), though the narrow Seed-stage cohort in this sector presents meaningful constraint on peer-derived benchmarking.

A stage-progression methodology was applied, using the $4M total-raised proxy as a base and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $9M. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable; while 10 same-sector comparables exist (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI), fewer than three qualified datapoints emerged within tight same-stage or adjacent-stage filters, making broader-sample medians unreliably directional for a Seed-stage target.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $7M–$10M, with a median of $9M. Key uncertainties include the limited Seed-stage comp density in robotics and manufacturing, which constrains validation of the stage-progression multiplier, and the absence of recent round economics from narrow peer transactions. Refinement would require additional Seed-stage robotics data or transaction evidence from the identified peer set.
